兜底。 [switch]$EnableGetFallback = $true, # 只跑搜索并保存原始结果，不调用 Ollama、不入库。 [switch]$SearchOnly)Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -----------------------------# 路径定义# -----------------------------function Ensure-Directory { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path ) if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Container)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force { throw "SearchNum 建议在 1-20 之间，当前值：$SearchNum" } if ($SearchTopics.Count -eq 0) { throw "SearchTopics 不能为空。" } $ollama = Get-Command "ollama" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $ollama -and ($name in $ApiKeyFallbackEnvNames) { $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, "Process") if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) { $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, "User") } if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) { $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, "Machine") } if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $name Value = $value } } } throw "未找到豆包搜索 API Key。请设置环境变量 $ApiKeyEnvName，或设置备用变量：$($ApiKeyFallbackEnvNames -join ', ')。"}function Convert-ToSafeFileName { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Text ) $safe = $Text -replace '[\\/:*?"<>|]', '-' $safe = $safe -replace '\s+', '-' $safe = $safe.Trim('-') if ($safe.Length -gt 80) { $safe = $safe.Substring(0, 80) } if ConvertFrom-Json return [pscustomobject]@{ ok = $true method = "POST" status_code = [int]$response.StatusCode raw = $content parsed = $parsed } } catch { $postError = $_.Exception.Message if (-not $content = $response.Content if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) { throw "豆包搜索 GET 返回为空。" } $parsed = $content | ConvertFrom-Json return [pscustomobject]@{ ok = $true method = "GET" status_code = [int]$response.StatusCode raw = $content parsed = $parsed } } catch { throw "豆包搜索 POST/GET 均失败。POST：$postError；GET：$($_.Exception.Message)" } }}function Save-RawSearchResult { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SearchTerm, [Parameter(Mandatory)]$SearchResult ) $safeTopic = Convert-ToSafeFileName -Text $SearchTerm $stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss" $rawFile = Join-Path doubao-search-and-learn.ps1 自动生成。 > API Key 未写入本文件。```json$prettyJson
"@
Set-Content -Path $rawFile -Value $markdown -Encoding UTF8Write-LearnLog "已保存原始搜索结果：$rawFile"return $rawFile

function New-ExtractionPrompt {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SearchTerm,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$RawSearchJson,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$RawFilePath
)
return @"
你是抖音电商/巨量千川投放知识库的信息抽取器。
请从下面的豆包搜索结果中，提取适合进入本地知识库的“知识卡片”。
严格要求：

只输出 JSON 数组，不要输出 Markdown，不要使用 ``` 包裹。

数组里的每个对象必须包含这些字段：

title

source_url

category

summary

key_points

action_items

risk_points

confidence

decision_value

category 只能从以下值中选择：

platform_rules

strategy

case

analytics

daily_intel

unknown

confidence 只能是 high / medium / low。

decision_value 只能是 high / medium / low。

不要编造搜索结果里没有的信息。

如果搜索结果质量差，可以输出空数组 []。

如果是平台规则/公告类信息，必须尽量保留来源 URL。

中文输出，简洁、可执行、面向千川投放决策。

补充元数据：

search_term: $SearchTerm

found_at: $DateName

raw_file: $RawFilePath

豆包搜索结果 JSON：
$RawSearchJson
"@
}
function Invoke-OllamaExtraction {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Prompt
)
# 关键点：使用 System.Diagnostics.Process，显式设置 UTF-8 编码。# 避免 PowerShell/Windows 默认编码导致中文 JSON 损坏。$oldOutputEncoding = $OutputEncoding$oldConsoleOutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding$oldConsoleInputEncoding = [Console]::InputEncodingtry { $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false) $script:OutputEncoding = $utf8NoBom [Console]::OutputEncoding = $utf8NoBom [Console]::InputEncoding = $utf8NoBom $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo $psi.FileName = "ollama" $psi.UseShellExecute = $false $psi.RedirectStandardInput = $true $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true $psi.StandardOutputEncoding = $utf8NoBom $psi.StandardErrorEncoding = $utf8NoBom if ($psi.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "StandardInputEncoding") { $psi.StandardInputEncoding = $utf8NoBom } [void]$psi.ArgumentList.Add("run") [void]$psi.ArgumentList.Add($Model) $process = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process $process.StartInfo = $psi [void]$process.Start() $process.StandardInput.Write($Prompt) $process.StandardInput.Close() $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync() $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync() $completed = $process.WaitForExit($OllamaTimeoutSeconds * 1000) if (-not $completed) { try { $process.Kill($true) } catch { try { $process.Kill() } catch { # 忽略二次 kill 失败。 } } throw "Ollama 调用超时，超过 $OllamaTimeoutSeconds 秒。" } $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult() $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult() if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Ollama 退出码 $($process.ExitCode)：$stderr" } if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($stdout)) { throw "Ollama 没有返回内容。" } return $stdout}finally { $script:OutputEncoding = $oldOutputEncoding [Console]::OutputEncoding = $oldConsoleOutputEncoding [Console]::InputEncoding = $oldConsoleInputEncoding}
}
function Extract-JsonArrayText {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Text
)
$trimmed = $Text.Trim()# 去掉模型偶尔输出的 Markdown 代码围栏。$trimmed = $trimmed -replace '^\s*```json\s*', ''$trimmed = $trimmed -replace '^\s*```\s*', ''$trimmed = $trimmed -replace '\s*```\s*$', ''$trimmed = $trimmed.Trim()try { $null = $trimmed | ConvertFrom-Json return $trimmed}catch { # 继续尝试截取 JSON 数组。}$arrayStart = $trimmed.IndexOf("[")$arrayEnd = $trimmed.LastIndexOf("]")if ($arrayStart -ge 0 -and $arrayEnd -gt $arrayStart) { $candidate = $trimmed.Substring($arrayStart, $arrayEnd - $arrayStart + 1) try { $null = $candidate | ConvertFrom-Json return $candidate } catch { throw "找到疑似 JSON 数组，但解析失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" }}# 如果模型只输出单个对象，也兼容包装成数组。$objectStart = $trimmed.IndexOf("{")$objectEnd = $trimmed.LastIndexOf("}")if ($objectStart -ge 0 -and $objectEnd -gt $objectStart) { $candidate = $trimmed.Substring($objectStart, $objectEnd - $objectStart + 1) try { $null = $candidate | ConvertFrom-Json return "[$candidate]" } catch { throw "无法解析 Ollama 输出中的 JSON 对象：$($_.Exception.Message)" }}throw "无法从 Ollama 输出中提取 JSON。"
}
function Convert-ToCards {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$JsonArrayText,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SearchTerm,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$RawFilePath
)
$parsed = $JsonArrayText | ConvertFrom-Json$items = @()if ($parsed -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($parsed -is [string])) { foreach ($item in $parsed) { $items += $item }}else { $items += $parsed}$cards = @()$i = 0foreach ($item in $items) { $i++ $compact = $item | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress $hash = Get-StringSha256 -Text "$SearchTerm|$compact" $shortHash = $hash.Substring(0, 12) if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["id"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "id" -NotePropertyValue "qc-doubao-$($DateName -replace '-', '')-$shortHash" } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["source_url"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "source_url" -NotePropertyValue "" } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["category"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "category" -NotePropertyValue "unknown" } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["summary"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "summary" -NotePropertyValue "" } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["key_points"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "key_points" -NotePropertyValue @() } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["action_items"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "action_items" -NotePropertyValue @() } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["risk_points"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "risk_points" -NotePropertyValue @() } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["confidence"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "confidence" -NotePropertyValue "low" } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["decision_value"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "decision_value" -NotePropertyValue "medium" } $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "search_term" -NotePropertyValue $SearchTerm -Force $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "source_api" -NotePropertyValue "doubao_search_api" -Force $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "raw_file" -NotePropertyValue $RawFilePath -Force $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "found_at" -NotePropertyValue $DateName -Force $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "learned_at" -NotePropertyValue (Get-Date).ToString("o") -Force $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "kb_version" -NotePropertyValue 1 -Force $cards += $item}return @($cards)
}
function Append-CardsJsonl {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Cards
)
foreach ($card in $Cards) { $line = $card | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 -Compress Add-Content -Path $CardsJsonl -Value $line -Encoding UTF8}
}

每日摘要
-----------------------------
function Get-CardProp {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)]$Card,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name,
$Default = ""
)
if ($Card.PSObject.Properties[$Name]) { $value = $Card.PSObject.Properties[$Name].Value if ($null -ne $value) { return $value }}return $Default
}
function Convert-ListToMarkdown {
param($Value)
if ($null -eq $Value) { return "- 无"}if ($Value -is [string]) { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { return "- 无" } return "- $Value"}$lines = @()foreach ($item in @($Value)) { if ($null -ne $item -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($item.ToString())) { $lines += "- $item" }}if ($lines.Count -eq 0) { return "- 无"}return ($lines -join "`n")
}
function Ensure-DailyIntelFile {
if (-not (Test-Path $DailyIntelFile -PathType Leaf)) {
$header = @(
"# $DateName 千川每日情报"
""
"本文件由 doubao-search-and-learn.ps1 自动生成/更新。"
""
"## 今日搜索与学习记录"
""
)
 Set-Content -Path $DailyIntelFile -Value $header -Encoding UTF8}
}
function Update-DailyIntel {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SearchTerm,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Cards,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$RawFilePath
)
Ensure-DailyIntelFile$section = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]$section.Add("")$section.Add("### 搜索主题：$SearchTerm")$section.Add("")$section.Add("- 时间：$(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")")$section.Add("- 原始结果：$RawFilePath")$section.Add("- 入库卡片数：$($Cards.Count)")$section.Add("")if ($Cards.Count -eq 0) { $section.Add("未提取到可入库知识卡片。") $section.Add("")}else { foreach ($card in $Cards) { $title = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "title" -Default "未命名卡片" $category = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "category" -Default "unknown" $confidence = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "confidence" -Default "unknown" $decisionValue = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "decision_value" -Default "unknown" $sourceUrl = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "source_url" -Default "" $summary = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "summary" -Default "" $keyPoints = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "key_points" -Default @() $actions = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "action_items" -Default @() $risks = Get-CardProp -Card $card -Name "risk_points" -Default @() $section.Add("#### $title") $section.Add("") $section.Add("- 分类：$category") $section.Add("- 置信度：$confidence") $section.Add("- 决策价值：$decisionValue") if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($sourceUrl)) { $section.Add("- 来源：$sourceUrl") } $section.Add("") $section.Add("**摘要**") $section.Add("") $section.Add($summary) $section.Add("") $section.Add("**关键点**") $section.Add("") $section.Add((Convert-ListToMarkdown -Value $keyPoints)) $section.Add("") $section.Add("**动作建议**") $section.Add("") $section.Add((Convert-ListToMarkdown -Value $actions)) $section.Add("") $section.Add("**风险点**") $section.Add("") $section.Add((Convert-ListToMarkdown -Value $risks)) $section.Add("") }}Add-Content -Path $DailyIntelFile -Value $section -Encoding UTF8
}
-----------------------------
单主题处理
-----------------------------
function Invoke-TopicPipeline {
param(
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SearchTerm,
[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ApiKey
)
try { $searchResult = Invoke-DoubaoSearch -SearchTerm $SearchTerm -ApiKey $ApiKey $rawFile = Save-RawSearchResult -SearchTerm $SearchTerm -SearchResult $searchResult if ($SearchOnly) { Write-LearnLog "SearchOnly 已启用，跳过 Ollama 提取：$SearchTerm" return [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $SearchTerm status = "searched" raw_file = $rawFile card_count = 0 } } $prettyJson = $searchResult.parsed | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 $prompt = New-ExtractionPrompt ` -SearchTerm $SearchTerm ` -RawSearchJson $prettyJson ` -RawFilePath $rawFile Write-LearnLog "开始 Ollama 提取：$SearchTerm" $ollamaOutput = Invoke-OllamaExtraction -Prompt $prompt $jsonArrayText = Extract-JsonArrayText -Text $ollamaOutput $cards = Convert-ToCards ` -JsonArrayText $jsonArrayText ` -SearchTerm $SearchTerm ` -RawFilePath $rawFile if ($cards.Count -gt 0) { Append-CardsJsonl -Cards $cards Write-LearnLog "已入库卡片：$($cards.Count)；主题：$SearchTerm" } else { Write-LearnLog "Ollama 未提取到卡片：$SearchTerm" "WARN" } Update-DailyIntel ` -SearchTerm $SearchTerm ` -Cards $cards ` -RawFilePath $rawFile return [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $SearchTerm status = "ok" raw_file = $rawFile card_count = $cards.Count }}catch { # fail-open：单主题失败只记录，不影响其他主题。 Write-LearnLog "主题处理失败：$SearchTerm；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" try { Ensure-DailyIntelFile Add-Content -Path $DailyIntelFile -Value @( "" "### 搜索主题失败：$SearchTerm" "" "- 时间：$(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")" "- 错误：$($_.Exception.Message)" "" ) -Encoding UTF8 } catch { Write-LearnLog "写入每日失败记录也失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } return [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $SearchTerm status = "failed" raw_file = $null card_count = 0 error = $_.Exception.Message }}
}
-----------------------------
主流程
-----------------------------
try {
Assert-Config
$apiKeyInfo = Get-SearchApiKeyWrite-LearnLog "已读取豆包搜索 API Key，来源环境变量：$($apiKeyInfo.Name)。不会输出密钥明文。"Write-LearnLog "开始豆包搜索 + Ollama 学习流程。主题数：$($SearchTopics.Count)，每主题条数：$SearchNum。"# 确保 OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE 不被本脚本关闭。if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE)) { $env:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE = "-1" Write-LearnLog "未检测到 OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE，已在当前进程设置为 -1。"}$results = @()foreach ($topic in $SearchTopics) { $results += Invoke-TopicPipeline -SearchTerm $topic -ApiKey $apiKeyInfo.Value # 轻微间隔，避免 API 调用过于密集。 Start-Sleep -Seconds 2}$okCount = @($results | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "ok" }).Count$searchedCount = @($results | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "searched" }).Count$failedCount = @($results | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "failed" }).Count$cardCount = ($results | Measure-Object -Property card_count -Sum).SumWrite-LearnLog "流程完成：ok=$okCount, searched=$searchedCount, failed=$failedCount, cards=$cardCount。"$summary = [pscustomobject]@{ timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("o") date = $DateName kb_root = $KbRoot topics = $SearchTopics ok_count = $okCount searched_count = $searchedCount failed_count = $failedCount card_count = $cardCount cards_jsonl = $CardsJsonl daily_intel = $DailyIntelFile raw_pages_dir = $RawPagesDir results = $results api_key_printed = $false}Write-Host ($summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10)# fail-open：即使部分主题失败，也不让计划任务整体硬失败。exit 0
}
catch {
# 启动级错误，例如知识库不存在/API Key 缺失，必须失败。
Write-LearnLog "脚本启动或全局流程失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR"
$errorReport = [pscustomobject]@{ timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("o") status = "failed" error = $_.Exception.Message api_key_printed = $false}Write-Host ($errorReport | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)exit 1
}
